ideas.name: G10 Interest Differential Carry
ideas.claim: Rank G10 currencies by one-month interest rates, hold higher-rate currencies long and lower-rate currencies short, and weight positions by the interest rate differential.
ideas.quote: Portfolios are rebalanced monthly, and allocations to individual currencies are weighted in proportion to the interest rate differential.

rules.entry: Go long high-interest-rate currencies and short low-interest-rate currencies, weighting positions by the interest rate differential.
rules.filters: Rank currencies using prevailing one-month LIBOR rates.

ideas.claimed_result: The paper reports a 5.21% annualized mean return for the spread-weighted portfolio from January 1990 to June 2012.
